metadata.scope: All Item, MagicItem, Spell and Creature fixtures for SRD 2014 and SRD 2024, matching current Lootsplit import filters. Not the full third-party Open5e catalog.
metadata.sourceMethod: Open5e official GitHub fixtures; live API returned HTTP 403 in research environment. Live counts may differ.
metadata.matchingPolicy: Specific concept > name family > exact icon-name candidate > spell damage type > category > kind default. Generic shared icons explicitly permitted by user. Icon paths verified; visual/semantic review not completed for every record.

sharedIconPolicy: Intentional: categories and families share icons; no promise of distinct artwork per record.
